name: ZCQ_MT_VND_ATT_MAPPINGS
description: The ZCQ_MT_VND_ATTR_MAPPINGS table stores attribute level mappings between vendor and fusion.

columns.name: ZCQ_MT_VND_ATT_MAPPING_ID
columns.description: Primary Key for this table.

columns.name: ZCQ_MT_OBJECT_ID
columns.description: Foreign key, primary key of ZCQ_MT_OBJECTS.

columns.name: ATTR_NAME
columns.description: Fusion Attribute Name.

columns.name: VND_FIELD
columns.description: Vendor attribute name.

columns.name: RT_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate this mapping is applicable to real time.

columns.name: BT_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate that this mapping is applicable to batch.

columns.name: VLACCESSOR_FLAG
columns.description: To indicate this attribute is a view link accessor. Internal use.

columns.name: VND_COLLECTION_OBJ
columns.description: Vendor collection name.

columns.name: VND_FIELD_CATEGORY
columns.description: To indicate the vendor field is a simple object or complex object or attribute.

columns.name: IDENTIFIER_FLAG
columns.description: To indicate if this attribute is an Id.

columns.name: DISPLAY_FLAG
columns.description: To indicate if this mapping is displayed on the UI.

columns.name: INPUT_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate this mapping is applicable to cleanse input.

columns.name: OUTPUT_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate this mapping is applicable to cleanse output.

columns.name: ZCQ_NAME
columns.description: DQ External Attribute Name

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
